blocks.text:
The CSS
text-transform property is used to
control the capitalization of text in an element.

It can be used to transform a text into uppercase or lowercase letters, or
capitalize the first letter of each word, without changing the original content
in HTML.
This property can have one of the following values:

items: none - No transformation. Text renders as it is
capitalize - Transforms the first character of each word to uppercase
uppercase - Transforms all characters to uppercase
lowercase - Transforms all characters to lowercase
